Note: A person who has had a non-intimate sample taken under any of the powers in
section 63 mentioned in paragraph 6.6 on two occasions in relation to any offence
may not be required under Schedule 2A to attend a police station for a sample to be
taken again under section 63 in relation to that offence, unless authorised by an officer
of inspector rank or above. The fact of the authorisation and the reasons for giving it
